_comment: B0d: D5 4,500（A0 原划分）+ 与 B0 完全同一套门控子带融合头 (gate_init=0.05) 与内部早停（真停）。用来把 B0 vs B0d 的差值归因为纯数据效应、B0d vs A0 的差值归因为纯门控头效应。

ablation.name: B0d_d5_b96_rawHF_head
ablation.notes: D5 4500 (A0 split) + same gate head/early stop as B0. 47 steps/epoch => ~700 steps over 15 epochs. Answers (a) head-only effect vs A0 (no head) and (b) whether D0's ratio 0.7238@ep2 / 0.9904@ep3 ever triggers over the full 15-epoch cosine.
